articles.summary: Round–robin tournament will feature eight teams from around the country USA TODAY Sports, part of USA TODAY Co., Inc. (NYSE: TDAY) and PlayVS, North America’s leading scholastic and collegiate gaming platform, today announced the official launch of the USA TODAY Sports National High School Esports Championship. The event builds on the momentum of the USA TODAY SUPER 25 Esports Rankings, launched by USA TODAY Sports and PlayVS in 2024, to recognize North America’s top high school esports teams. As part of USA TODAY Sports’ expanding commitment to high school sports, the esports championship provides a national platform to spotlight student-athletes, celebrate emerging competition, and showcase the communities, schools and stories driving the next generation of sports. The round-robin tournament will feature eight of the nation’s top high school esports teams competing in three games on the PlayVS platform: EA Sports Madden NFL, Marvel Rivals, and Rocket League.
